adopt: Host a mesh on one machine and join it from another.
description:
Kind: runtime

Problem
Agents are islands. Every deployment reinvents how a peer is found, addressed and trusted, so two agents on two machines cost more to introduce than either cost to build — and the answers (port forwards, a VPN per pair, public IPs, a broker somebody has to run) all become permanent maintenance.

Install
pip install git+https://github.com/Aitherium/awnet.git
